scripts.build:packages: tsc -b packages/engine-core packages/app-contracts packages/audio-web packages/platform-node packages/platform-web packages/renderer-pixi apps/server
scripts.typecheck:packages: tsc -b packages/engine-core packages/app-contracts packages/audio-web packages/platform-node packages/platform-web packages/renderer-pixi apps/server --pretty false
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:packages && npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:desktop && tsc -b --pretty false
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && npm --workspace @graph1ks/emo-web test
